sourceCoverage: Every new course and step has at least two primary official-document/paper references. Some historical V10 IDs remain global sources and are intentionally preserved.
limitations: Conceptual workshop, not a full hardware or production-network simulator.
No live exploit, third-party scan or real infrastructure changes.
Maps are explicit representative addresses/cities, never invention/factory/visit claims.
References linked only; no third-party artwork or text copied.
Hypothetical examples are independently authored, not vendor benchmark data.
numericAuditNote: Every worked example checked independently for dimensions and arithmetic. IPC model explicitly assumes CPU time, not elapsed latency. IEEE-like frame accounting is an assumed instructional model; all hardware numbers are non-vendor hypothetical inputs.
